```
['build a torchvision Compose pipeline for cell image classification evaluation with center crop and self normalization', 'create a PyTorch module that divides by 255 then normalizes image pixels by per-image mean and std', 'create a transform that randomly rescales contrast of the protein channel in multi-channel cell images', 'create a transform that randomly blackens one channel from multi-channel microscopy images with configurable probability', 'create a transform that applies random brightness adjustment to each channel of a multi-channel image']
```
